operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case identifiers: Member_ID, Card_Number, Open_year, membership_amount, Total_pounds; must be double-quoted in generated SQL.
FK child columns declared TEXT but parent PKs are INT (membership_register_branch.Branch_ID text -> branch.Branch_ID int; purchase.Branch_ID text -> branch.Branch_ID int).
Year-like columns stored as TEXT: branch.Open_year, membership_register_branch.Register_Year, purchase.Year — declared TEXT so TS dispatches String, not Date/Number.
Numeric-looking TEXT columns: branch.membership_amount ('112','11','6','7','1418') and Card_Number ('LE99','LT98') — String fuzzer will emit random charset strings, not numbers.
purchase has composite PK (Member_ID, Branch_ID, Year) — composite-PK member columns get max_l0=30 cap in TS.
membership_register_branch PK is Member_ID only (single-col PK -> max_l0=inf) but also FK to member; PK uniqueness filtering will drop rows.
No NOT NULL constraints anywhere; all notnull=0, so TS may emit NULLs and sqlite accepts them.
No CHECK constraints; checked=False for all columns, so p stays 0.2 (not forced to 0).
Small tables (8-10 rows) — original_values sampling k=min(5,len) gives 5 draws with replacement from tiny pools.
branch.City has only 2 distinct values ('London','Oxford') — String fuzzer's fresh draws will dominate and destroy the 2-value domain.
member.Hometown has comma-space format ('Collierville, Tennessee') — String fuzzer contaminate will mangle it.
All FKs point to existing parents with unique PKs; no dangling FKs, no self-references, no non-unique parents.
operator_ts_expectations: Number fuzzer on Member_ID/Branch_ID/Level/Total_pounds: uniform in [-10^scale,10^scale] then +-1/+-2 (int) or +-0.01/+-0.02 (real) perturbation; Level (distinct 3: 2,4,6) will be flooded with implausible values.

String fuzzer on Card_Number/Name/Hometown/Open_year/City/membership_amount/Register_Year/Year: random charset a-zA-Z 0-9() strings of length 0-20, plus 50% contaminate — destroys 'LE99' style codes and '2016'/'2017' year strings.
Open_year/Register_Year/Year declared TEXT -> String fuzzer, NOT Date fuzzer; TS will not produce plausible years, likely FN on year-range predicates.
membership_amount TEXT -> String fuzzer emits non-numeric strings; queries comparing membership_amount numerically will get implausible values (FN).

FK fill: membership_register_branch.Branch_ID (TEXT) draws from branch.Branch_ID (INT) values with replacement — type mismatch but sqlite affinity coerces; may produce values not in branch if parent filtered.
Composite PK purchase: sample_fresh_primary_keys drops duplicate (Member_ID,Branch_ID,Year) tuples; with small parent pools duplicates likely, shrinking purchase rows.
membership_register_branch single-col PK Member_ID: drop_unique_duplicates removes repeated Member_IDs, so at most 10 rows survive.
Small original tables (8-10 rows) mean original_values pool is tiny; TS fresh draws (p=0.2) dominate and produce values far from original domain.
No NOT NULL/CHECK: TS emits NULLs freely; queries with IS NOT NULL or comparisons may see many NULLs (FP/FN).
Level (2,4,6) and City (2 values) are low-cardinality; TS fresh draws destroy ties/duplicates that gold queries may rely on (FP from missing ties).
Total_pounds REAL: Number fuzzer scale=4 -> range [-10000,10000] plus +-0.01/+-0.02; plausible magnitude but random, may miss exact-value predicates.
